author: gpt-6
subject_and_construction:
Kiwi bird with rounded body, small head, long downcurved beak and two feet. Lucide bird informs simple legs and smooth body. Omit tiny eye and lower beak outline; retain distinctive long bill and directional profile.
Keyshape HRECT_L: exact SOLO48 envelope; 4px stroke.
user_specification: Smooth even centerlines, true straight lines, clean joins and corners, consistent stroke, symmetry where the subject is symmetric, same concept.
visual_review: Original reference and rejected drawing inspected. Final native48 and enlarged previews reviewed in light and dark: coherent centerlines, consistent strokes, retained subject and intended asymmetry.
revision_summary: Smooth rounded body and long curved bill; clean leg joins and clear feet.
